unit.description: package or loose; one whole outer pallet or one loose move line

package_id.description: Outermost package ID, or false for loose goods

package_count.description: One for a package, zero for loose goods

product_id.description: Single product ID or false for multiple products

product_ids.description: All product IDs in the allocation unit

lot_id.description: Move line product-specific lot ID or false

batch_name.description: Single known batch name across the whole unit, else false

has_single_batch_name.description: Exactly one batch name and no untracked contents

has_unknown_batch.description: At least one positive-quantity content has no batch name

quantities.description: Product IDs as string keys; quantities in each product base UoM

quantity.description: Loose quantity in base UoM; false for a whole package

rule_id.description: Current native putaway rule ID or false

system_priority.description: Native rule priority; cannot be overridden by AI score

same_lot.description: Location has a matching product and lot-name pair

same_picking.description: Current picking has pending goods here, or completed goods still present

empty.description: No positive stock or pending positive-quantity goods

batch_name_matches.description: All known contents match the incoming batch name, with no unknown batch

batch_names.description: Distinct stock and pending batch names

has_unknown_batch.description: Positive stock or pending goods without a batch name

current_product_qty.description: Stock plus pending quantity of the current line product

occupied_packages.description: Distinct outer matching-type pallets, stock plus pending; zero for loose

package_capacity.description: Configured package-type capacity, or false if absent

packages_after.description: Distinct pallets after this allocation; zero for loose

max_quantity.description: Current line quantity for an accepted whole package, or allowed loose quantity

fits_all.description: True for a whole accepted pallet; loose quantity fits in full

input.trial_payload: request is a JSON object; candidates have unique integer location_id. Include every field read by this code.

syntax.assignment: Assign to a single local variable; request, candidates and candidate are read-only.
syntax.loop: for candidate in candidates; no nested loops or for/else
syntax.conditions: if/elif/else, conditional expressions, and/or/not, comparisons, in/not in
syntax.arithmetic: +, -, *, / with finite bounded numbers only; no string multiplication or concatenation
syntax.lookup: Existing string keys of JSON dictionaries via brackets only; no list indexing

item.location_id: unique integer from approved candidates; a subset is allowed

output.empty_result: No destination approved by this enhancement; never relax native constraints.

tests.note: Pure interpreter trials do not replace real picking preview or native priority/capacity checks.

business_invariants: Native rules determine scope and precedence; enhancement only filters or ranks approved candidates.
Capacity, pallet count, weight, product mixing, stock restrictions and company access remain enforced.
A whole pallet is atomic; only loose goods may split when capacity is insufficient.
Batch-name equality can span products; lot IDs are product-specific.
A picking and native-rule binding keeps its first selected release; publication affects later bindings.
AI may save and validate drafts. A local inventory manager publishes or rolls back.
